tweets.text:
claude code can be either goated or a mess - depends entirely on how you use it.

here's a high-leverage workflow i've learned from others:
🧠 use claude for planning:
- generate PRD, tech specs, task breakdown
- create test cases early
- write https://t.co/lKa6qAis48 with best practices

🔁 iterate on the plan:
- refine line-by-line with claude
- don’t just one-shot the whole build

🧷 version control matters:
- git commit often
- feed commits into prompts
- no easy checkpoint restore like cursor

⚠️ early users: review everything. hallucinations sneak in.
🛠️ for bugfixes/micro-edits:
- cursor or or amp with gpt o3 might still be better for this
